use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
const NS: &str = "urn:collections:policy";
fn number(coefficient: &str, scale: i32) -> Value {
    Value::Number {
        coefficient: coefficient.into(),
        scale,
    }
}
fn record(fields: impl IntoIterator<Item = (&'static str, Value)>) -> Value {
    Value::Record(fields.into_iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.into(), v)).collect())
}
fn inputs(scenario: usize, include: Value) -> BTreeMap<(&'static str, &'static str), Value> {
    let fees = match scenario {
        1 => Value::List(vec![]),
        2 => Value::Null,
        _ => Value::List(vec![number("1000", 2), Value::Null, number("-25", 1)]),
    };
    let dates = match scenario {
        1 => Value::List(vec![]),
        2 => Value::Null,
        _ => Value::List(vec![
            Value::Date {
                year: -400,
                month: 2,
                day: 29,
            },
            Value::Null,
            Value::Date {
                year: 10000,
                month: 1,
                day: 1,
            },
        ]),
    };
    let permit = if scenario == 3 {
        Value::Null
    } else {
        record([
            (
                "Expiry",
                Value::Date {
                    year: if scenario == 5 { 2023 } else { 2024 },
                    month: 2,
                    day: if scenario == 5 { 28 } else { 29 },
                },
            ),
            ("Previous Dates", dates),
            ("Previous Fees", fees),
        ])
    };
    let external = match scenario {
        6 => Value::Null,
        7 => Value::List(vec![]),
        _ => Value::List(vec![number("1250", 3), Value::Null, number("1250", 3)]),
    };
    BTreeMap::from([
        (
            (NS, "applicant"),
            if scenario == 4 {
                Value::Null
            } else {
                record([("Permit", permit)])
            },
        ),
        ((NS, "include"), include),
        ((NS, "external"), external),
    ])
}
fn encode(value: &Value) -> String {
    match value {
        Value::Null => "N".into(),
        Value::Boolean(true) => "T".into(),
        Value::Boolean(false) => "F".into(),
        Value::Text(text) => format!("S{text}"),
        Value::Number { coefficient, scale } => format!("D{coefficient},{scale}"),
        Value::Date { year, month, day } => format!("A{year},{month},{day}"),
        Value::List(values) => format!(
            "[{}]",
            values.iter().map(encode).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("|")
        ),
        _ => panic!("unexpected record result"),
    }
}
#[test]
fn collections_match_java_and_preserve_order_and_nulls() {
    let mut count = 0;
    for line in include_str!("collection_vectors.tsv").lines() {
        let columns: Vec<_> = line.split('\t').collect();
        let include = match columns[1] {
            "T" => Value::Boolean(true),
            "F" => Value::Boolean(false),
            _ => Value::Null,
        };
        let result = evaluate(&inputs(columns[0].parse().unwrap(), include));
        if columns[2] == "ERROR" {
            assert!(result.is_err(), "{line}");
        } else {
            let actual = result
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .map(|((_, id), v)| format!("{id}={}", encode(v)))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(";");
            assert_eq!(actual, columns[2], "{line}");
        }
        count += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!(count, 24);
}
#[test]
fn typed_collections_reject_invalid_shapes_and_elements() {
    for invalid in [
        number("1", 0),
        Value::List(vec![Value::Text("1".into())]),
        Value::List(vec![Value::List(vec![])]),
        Value::List(vec![number("01", 0)]),
    ] {
        let mut values = inputs(0, Value::Boolean(true));
        values.insert((NS, "external"), invalid);
        assert!(evaluate(&values).is_err());
    }
    for invalid in [
        Value::List(vec![Value::Date {
            year: 0,
            month: 1,
            day: 1,
        }]),
        Value::List(vec![number("1", 0)]),
    ] {
        let mut values = inputs(0, Value::Boolean(true));
        let Value::Record(applicant) = values.get_mut(&(NS, "applicant")).unwrap() else {
            panic!()
        };
        let Value::Record(permit) = applicant.get_mut("Permit").unwrap() else {
            panic!()
        };
        permit.insert("Previous Dates".into(), invalid);
        assert!(evaluate(&values).is_err());
    }
}
